Code.Name: Passenger, normal service (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled passenger flight. Cargo is carried in the hold in addition to the passengers.

Code.Name: Passenger, shuttle mode (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled passenger flight operated in shuttle mode.

Code.Name: Passenger, operated by surface vehicle (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled passenger service operated by a surface vehicle under a flight number.

Code.Name: Passenger, normal service (additional flight)
Code.Description: Additional passenger flight outside the published schedule.

Code.Name: Passenger, shuttle mode (additional flight)
Code.Description: Additional passenger flight operated in shuttle mode.

Code.Name: Passenger only (charter)
Code.Description: Charter flight carrying passengers only.

Code.Name: Cargo, loose loaded and/or preloaded devices (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled freighter flight. The aircraft carries cargo only, no passengers.

Code.Name: Mail only (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled flight carrying mail only.

Code.Name: Cargo, operated by surface vehicle (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled cargo service operated by a surface vehicle under a flight number, known as road feeder service.

Code.Name: Cargo and/or mail (additional flight)
Code.Description: Additional cargo flight outside the published schedule.

Code.Name: Cargo and/or mail (charter)
Code.Description: Charter flight carrying cargo and/or mail.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo in cabin, mixed configuration (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled flight on an aircraft configured for both passengers and cargo in the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo in cabin, mixed configuration (additional flight)
Code.Description: Additional flight on an aircraft configured for both passengers and cargo in the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo and/or mail (charter)
Code.Description: Charter flight carrying passengers together with cargo and/or mail.

Code.Name: Charter requiring special handling
Code.Description: Charter flight that requires special handling.

Code.Name: Non-revenue (positioning, ferry, delivery, demonstration)
Code.Description: Flight operated without revenue load.

Code.Name: General aviation, non-commercial
Code.Description: General aviation flight, including empty flights.

Code.Name: Business aviation or air taxi
Code.Description: Business aviation or air taxi flight.

Code.Name: Special, government
Code.Description: Flight operated for a government or civil aviation authority.

Code.Name: Military
Code.Description: Military flight.

Code.Name: State or diplomatic
Code.Description: State or diplomatic flight.

Code.Name: Crew training
Code.Description: Flight operated for crew training.

Code.Name: Technical test
Code.Description: Flight operated for technical testing.

Code.Name: Technical stop
Code.Description: Technical stop, no commercial traffic.
